summary: Sherlock v2.0 end-to-end verification (backend + frontend). Confirmed REAL Apify Instagram data (no mocks). 17/17 pytest cases pass. Verified live values: @natgeo=268,965,455 followers (National Geographic, verified, business), @cristiano=677,873,612 followers, @therock=382M, @humansofny=12.6M. Emergent LLM (openai/gpt-5.4) insights endpoint returns real analysis with **Content Strategy**, **Audience**, **Engagement**, **Recommendation** sections. Frontend loads dark Sherlock theme with amber #d4a656 accents and ZERO blue-leaning pixels detected; navigation across Dashboard/Tracker/Activity/Ties&Trails/Reports/Search works; adding @natgeo via UI displays real 268M follower count; Search shows real profile; Reports renders growth + engagement charts with live data.

minor.issue: Apify actor intermittently returns latestPosts=[] for some accounts (observed for @natgeo on one call, other calls returned 12 posts). This makes /activity return [] when it occurs. This is an Apify actor data quirk, not a backend defect. Backend correctly serializes whatever Apify sends.
field 'category' returns the literal string 'None' when Apify's businessCategoryName is null (server.py falls back to 'personal' only when key is missing, not when value is the string 'None').
On LLM failure the endpoint returns HTTP 200 with an error message in 'insights' field; better to surface non-2xx so frontend can react.

integration_issues.issue: Instagram CDN images blocked by browser (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin due to Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin header). onError fallback hides the tag, but avatar/thumbnail slots render empty. Consider proxying images through backend or using an with 'crossorigin' left unset and a backend image proxy endpoint.

action_items: Optional: Add /api/image-proxy?url=... in backend that fetches Instagram media and streams it back to bypass CDN CORP so profile_pic and post display_url render in the browser.
Optional: In fetch_instagram_profile, treat businessCategoryName in ('None', None, '') uniformly and default to 'personal'.
Optional: Consider surfacing Apify actor 'no latestPosts' as a soft-warning in the profile response so UI can show a hint instead of a silent empty activity feed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses an in-process dict cache; will not scale across multiple workers or restarts. Acceptable for MVP.
add_tracked_account uses query param 'username' (POST /api/accounts?username=...) instead of a JSON body. Works, but not RESTful.
get_ai_insights swallows LLM exceptions and returns 200; caller cannot distinguish error from real analysis.
profile_cache has no size cap; long-running server could grow unbounded.
No rate limiting / auth on any endpoint; anyone can trigger Apify calls (billed by owner).
get_relationships builds nodes from an in-memory cache lookup only; freshly-restarted server will always return category='unknown' with no links until profiles are re-fetched.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Dashboard, Tracker add, Search, Reports, Map, Activity, dark theme, real data)

seed_data_creation: Added and then removed @natgeo tracked account during tests (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Apify is billed; every uncached /profile call takes ~10-40s and costs money. Backend caches profiles 15 min in-process. Test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses cristiano for the activity test because natgeo's Apify response intermittently omits latestPosts. If retesting AI insights, allow up to 180s (gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations). REAL follower counts to sanity-check: natgeo~268M, cristiano~677M, therock~382M, humansofny~12.6M.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs. Only image loading is degraded due to Instagram CDN's Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header, which is external and outside app control unless a backend image proxy is added.
